method: blind A/B, order-randomized, independent LLM judge, 4 criteria
verdict: FLAT lift overall. Brain wins recency(+1.0)+citation(+2.0), loses grounding(-2.0: judges distrust hyper-specific unverifiable claims). Net wash.
insight: Brain helps on recency/niche/citation, NOT well-known general knowledge (model already strong). Specificity reads as 'unverifiable' UNLESS presented WITH source URLs.
fix: recall must attach source URL to each fact (convert specificity->verifiable grounding)
trigger brain selectively: recency-sensitive/niche/project queries, not general knowledge
